profile.name: Ivan Bogomolov
profile.title: Frontend Engineer · React Native / React
profile.location: Volgograd, Russia · open to remote, hybrid and relocation
profile.summary: Frontend engineer with 5+ years of experience building mobile and web apps with React Native, React and TypeScript. I have shipped insurance apps with 50k+ users to the App Store, Google Play, AppGallery and RuStore, migrated a legacy React Native 0.64 codebase to 0.77 with the New Architecture, and written native modules for payments. Now building IoT products.

experience.summary: Building mobile apps for IoT products.
Insurance group. Two mobile apps — for clients and for insurance agents (50k+ users) — plus an internal CRM.
highlights: Upgraded both apps from React Native 0.64 to 0.77 and enabled the New Architecture.
Built SBP (Faster Payments System) payments through a custom native module for Android and iOS.
Implemented real-time chat over WebSocket, push notifications and biometric login (Face ID / Touch ID).
Built in-app updates without third-party libraries.
Released apps to the App Store / TestFlight, Google Play, AppGallery and RuStore; monitored crashes with Sentry.
Moved legacy code to Redux Toolkit + RTK Query + TypeScript and Feature-Sliced Design.
React: internal CRM, product metrics, user analytics and hypothesis testing.

experience.summary: Enterprise product for the bank's internal users.
highlights: Designed the app architecture on React + Redux Toolkit + TypeScript.
Worked with the GraphQL API through Apollo Client.
Rebuilt the website's main page pixel-perfect to the new design.
Created a UI kit for the new design system as a separate npm package (Ant Design + TypeScript).
Supported the in-site learning games; took part in cross code review and designing the new app architecture.

experience.summary: Outsourcing and outstaffing: React and React Native apps for clients, from new features to full support.
highlights: Analytics app (React Native): SVG charts (pie, bar, line, Gantt) and maps (Mapbox, OpenStreetMap); sped it up with memoization and a move from class components to hooks.
Mafia-style multiplayer game built from scratch: architecture, drag-and-drop animations, MVP on REST later moved to WebSockets.
Hotel guest app (React Native, Redux): new screens and bug fixes.
Web: education platform (introduced Redux), API testing tool similar to Postman, hotel CRM, document management and aircraft insurance sites.

items: New Architecture: Fabric, TurboModules, JSI, Codegen
